name: San Antonio Center
summary: San Antonio Center is a well-established outdoor retail park in Mountain View's Silicon Valley corridor, featuring big-box anchors, grocery stores, and diverse dining options. Managed by Federal Realty Investment Trust, this convenient shopping destination serves the local tech community and surrounding neighborhoods with essential retail and services.
demographics: San Antonio Center attracts a diverse, affluent Silicon Valley demographic with a median household income exceeding $150,000, primarily consisting of tech professionals, families, and young professionals aged 25-54. The trade area serves Mountain View and surrounding communities including Palo Alto, Los Altos, and Sunnyvale, drawing visitors who value convenience and quality over luxury. Shopping patterns reflect the busy lifestyles of dual-income households seeking one-stop shopping for groceries, services, and everyday retail needs, with strong weekday evening and weekend traffic from local residents.
description: San Antonio Center is a premier outdoor retail destination in the heart of Silicon Valley, strategically located on El Camino Real in Mountain View, California. Owned and operated by Federal Realty Investment Trust, a leading national retail real estate investment trust with a distinguished portfolio across major metropolitan markets, this shopping center has served the community as a convenient retail hub for decades. The center features a thoughtfully curated mix of big-box anchors, grocery options, dining establishments, and essential services, all arranged in an accessible open-air format that caters to the busy lifestyles of Silicon Valley residents. With its prime location near major tech campuses and residential neighborhoods, San Antonio Center offers ample parking and extended operating hours to accommodate the diverse needs of local shoppers. The property exemplifies Federal Realty's commitment to creating vibrant retail environments that serve as community gathering places while delivering exceptional value to both retailers and consumers.
